description: Retitle is the argument of the retitleTodo command.

id.description: ID names the todo to change.

refreshId.description: RefreshID names the getTodo the command will refresh afterwards. A real app would not take this from the caller — it would refresh what it knows it changed — but naming it here is what lets the page ask for a refresh of a todo other than the one it just wrote, which is the difference between "the refresh worked" and "the refresh went where its argument said".
